verdict: Accepted for the v3 disposable native QA run; no source-review blocker found. This does not claim macOS signing or native keychain runtime success.
signingReview: The shell is limited to CI on Intel macOS and builds the iphonesimulator SDK for x86_64 with a local ad-hoc identity. It introduces no Apple account, profile download, team identifier or physical-device signing path.
A nonempty ad-hoc identity allows normal Xcode product entitlement processing. The parser then inspects the actual generated QA executable rather than constructing an application identity.

The parser validates the QA Info.plist bundle/platform, a safe executable basename, thin x86_64 Mach-O, load-command/section bounds and PLATFORM_IOSSIMULATOR. It requires generated resolved QA application identity and valid optional keychain-group strings.
Both simulated XML and DER sections must be nonempty. XML is decoded; DER receives only presence/size/hash checks, explicitly not a semantic validation claim.
Before/after embedded section hashes and XML dictionaries must match around the existing plain deep ad-hoc re-sign. Deep strict signature verification and Signature=adhoc checks are mandatory.
Host signature entitlements are inspected separately and restricted to debug-access keys. iOS application/keychain entitlements are not injected into that host signature.
readbackReview: The helper is reachable only from the disposable capture route and checks QA fixture configuration plus the synthetic owner before reading. The production accountsStore source is unchanged.

accountsStore.init reloads the secure-storage index and each account through the actual SecureStore adapter, then replaces its in-memory account list. A caught write failure leaving only memory state cannot satisfy the readback.

The helper requires exactly one persisted account, matching owner and refresh token, matching currentId, and unchanged current owner/token after the await. Failure or session replacement cannot become a passed receipt.
Readback compares values only in memory. Fixture receipts retain only passed/reloaded booleans and accountCount; extra fields are discarded.

The actual capture flow waits for the semantic Saved account readback passed status. Final verification requires exactly one passed/reloaded one-account receipt, a successful index-save log, and no caught account save/index failures.
The existing Expo SecureStore native reader calls SecItemCopyMatching. No in-memory-only storage stub or keychain access-group override is introduced in the runtime app.

nestedPython.note: Executed within the single Node parser-wrapper case. Not nine additional Node cases.

independentVerification.restrictedExecutionNote: Initial restricted subprocess collection reported spawnSync python3 EPERM even while the Python reader output showed success. The unchanged narrow signing/parser Node file was rerun with approved execution permissions and all six cases passed; no assertions or guards were removed.

primarySourcesReviewed.finding: Product entitlement task creation requires a nonempty expanded signing identity.
Simulator signed host entitlements and simulated application entitlements are distinct; host entitlements are limited to debug access.
Apple documents codesign --display --entitlements - --xml for XML entitlement inspection.
getValueWithKeyAsync reaches SecItemCopyMatching; accessGroup is supplied only when present in options.

limits: This Linux review executed parser/plist fixtures and the extracted actual Python signing guard, not xcodebuild, codesign or a simulator keychain.
The prior missing-entitlement cause remains source/log-supported inference because its binary was not retained for inspection.
A refresh-token change during readback intentionally fails this one-session fixture check conservatively. No production account-switching or logout behavior is changed.
Readback proves an actual secure-storage reload within the running app; it does not claim an OS reboot, app reinstall, cross-device restore or physical-device persistence test.
The next full Intel Simulator build must prove generated identity, local signing, installation, launch, semantic navigation and SecureStore readback together.
mutationsPerformedByReviewer: Only this review receipt was written. No production/source edits, signing actions, Apple account access, pushes or hosted writes.
